name: Toxic Potion II
obtain: Toxic Potion II is not obtainable in version 1.010 of the game: no recipe, formula, trader, quest, battle, chest or gathering spot gives it, and no trader buys it.

name: Transmutation Potion I
obtain: Transmutation Potion I is not obtainable in version 1.010 of the game: no recipe, formula, trader, quest, battle, chest or gathering spot gives it, nothing uses it and no trader buys it.

name: Transmutation Potion II
obtain: Transmutation Potion II is not obtainable in version 1.010 of the game: no recipe, formula, trader, quest, battle, chest or gathering spot gives it, nothing uses it and no trader buys it.

name: Trilogy
obtain: Made at the Printing Press from 3 Blank Hardcover Notebook, 3 Ink and 3 Story. The quest Well-Deserved Rest takes it.

name: Trout
obtain: Caught at the Forest fishing spot.

name: Tuna
obtain: Caught at the Port Area fishing spot.

name: Tuna or Salmon
obtain: Wildcard ingredient: any one of the listed group members.

name: Umami
obtain: Brewed by alchemy from ingredients whose runes add up to 4 green and 4 blue. Sold by the Alchemist. At the Kitchen Table it turns a silver Wine, Grape Juice, Vegetable salad or Bowl of sauerkraut into gold.

name: Underground Conveyor
obtain: Underground Conveyor is built in the Factory for 4 Bronze Gear and 2 Fabric. Uses 1 Factory power. Unlocked by Conveyors.

name: Underground well
obtain: Underground well is a one-time fix that takes 2 Polished Bronze and 4 Polished Stone (Building mastery 3). It can only be repaired during The Nun with the Hairy Ass, after you answer the Nun "Corpse delivery.".

name: Unholy Idol
obtain: Unholy Idol is not obtainable in version 1.010 of the game: no recipe, formula, trader, quest, battle, chest or gathering spot gives it, nothing uses it and no trader buys it.

name: Universal bag
obtain: Sold by the Tailor. 9 slots for tools and most items.

name: Upgrade Bed
obtain: Upgrade Bed is built in the Home for 6 Wooden Plank, 4 Iron Detail and 3 Fabric. Unlocked by Bed Improvement.

name: Upgrade Fence I
obtain: Upgrade Fence I is built in the Graveyard for 12 Wooden Plank, 12 Bronze Nails and 12 Piece of stone. +10 graveyard quality. Unlocked by Graveyard Path and Fence I.

name: Upgrade Fence II
obtain: Upgrade Fence II is built in the Graveyard for 12 Polished Stone and 12 Marble Plate. +20 graveyard quality. Unlocked by Graveyard Path and Fence II.

name: Upgrade Road and Paths
obtain: Upgrade Road and Paths is built in the Graveyard for 24 Polished Stone. +10 graveyard quality. Unlocked by Graveyard Path and Fence I.

name: Upgrade Sawmill
obtain: Upgrade Sawmill is built in the Sawmill for 2 Wooden Plank and 4 Brick. Unlocked by Zombie Lumberjack II.

name: Urn with Ashes I
obtain: Made at the Formulation Bench from 3 Ash and 1 Clay Urn.

name: Urn with Ashes II
obtain: Made at the Formulation Bench from 3 Ash, 1 Clay Urn and 1 Polished Marble.

name: Vegetable salad (bronze)
obtain: Quality grade of the base item (star craft result or enhancement recipe).

name: Vegetable salad (gold)
obtain: Quality grade of the base item (star craft result or enhancement recipe).

name: Vegetable salad (silver)
obtain: Quality grade of the base item (star craft result or enhancement recipe).

name: Vegetable soup
obtain: Made at the Kitchen Oven from 2 Beet, 2 Carrot and 25 Fuel. Sold by the Tavern. Using it restores 25 energy (28 while Steamed Up lasts).

name: Victory Banner
obtain: A reward for winning Eastern Districts Purge, Central Districts Purge: Part II or one other battle.

name: Victory Flag
obtain: Victory Flag is not obtainable in version 1.010 of the game: no recipe, formula, trader, quest, battle, chest or gathering spot gives it, nothing uses it and no trader buys it.

name: Village toilet
obtain: Three toilets in the Village each yield 2 Peat and 2 green tech points when emptied. They refill after 30 minutes at normal game speed.

name: Vine Press
obtain: Vine Press is built in the Vineyard Basement for 6 Wooden Plank, 4 Wooden beam and 8 Iron Detail. Unlocked by Cold Pressing. Its construction site needs Building mastery 4: below that, hits do nothing.

name: Vine Trellis
obtain: Vine Trellis is built in the Vineyard for 5 Stick and 3 Peat. Unlocked by Vineyard. Its construction site needs Farming mastery 6: below that, hits do nothing.

name: Vineyard Bridge
obtain: Vineyard Bridge is a one-time fix that takes 4 Wooden Plank, 1 Polished Bronze and 4 Piece of stone (Building mastery 2).

name: Vineyard Upgrade
obtain: Vineyard Upgrade is built in the Vineyard for 6 Farming Fertilizer III, 6 Advanced Detail and 4 Oiled Beam. Unlocked by Vineyard Improvement.

name: Violin
obtain: A reward from Varnish Before You Fiddle. The quest Strings and Sinners takes it.

name: Votive Candle Stand I
obtain: Votive Candle Stand I cannot be built: nothing unlocks its blueprint.

name: Votive Candle Stand II
obtain: Votive Candle Stand II cannot be built: nothing unlocks its blueprint.

name: Walkway Area I
obtain: Walkway Area I is built in the Graveyard at no material cost. Adds a 12 x 12 area to the Graveyard; build limit: 2. Unlocked by Graveyard Decor I.

name: Walkway Area II
obtain: Walkway Area II cannot be built: nothing unlocks its blueprint.

name: Wanted Poster
obtain: Wanted Poster is not obtainable in version 1.010 of the game: no recipe, formula, trader, quest, battle, chest or gathering spot gives it, nothing uses it and no trader buys it.

name: Water
obtain: Gathered from water wells and the Garden Well II. Chests in the Alchemy Lab and Yard hold it when the game starts.

name: Weak growth elixir
obtain: Brewed by alchemy from ingredients whose runes add up to 1 red and 2 green. Sold by the Alchemist.

name: Weaving Loom
obtain: Weaving Loom is built in the Yard for 4 Wooden Plank, 2 Polished Bronze and 8 Bronze Nails. Unlocked by Fabric (Farming). Its construction site needs Building mastery 2: below that, hits do nothing.

name: Wheat
obtain: Grows in a Wheat Bed planted with 4 Wheat seed. Sold by Herm and the Vegetable Stand. The quest Planted and Delivered takes it.

name: Wheat Bed
obtain: A Wheat Bed is a Garden Bed planted with 4 Wheat seed. It grows Wheat, Wheat seed and Leaf on its own.

name: Wheat seed
obtain: Planting 4 in a Garden Bed turns it into a Wheat Bed, which yields Wheat and more seeds. Sold by Herm and the Vegetable Stand. It can be planted with any Farming mastery above 0; at Farming mastery 2 or more every planting tick succeeds, below that some ticks fail.

name: Wine
obtain: Made at the Wine Barrel from 4 Grape Juice. The Kitchen Table turns it into a better grade. Sold by the Brewery. Using it lowers insanity by 25 to 35.

name: Wine Barrel
obtain: Wine Barrel is built in the Vineyard Basement for 4 Oiled Plank, 8 Iron Nails and 2 Iron Detail. Unlocked by Winemaking. Its construction site needs Building mastery 4: below that, hits do nothing.

name: Wine (gold)
obtain: Made from ingredients of the same grade, or improved from the grade below.

name: Wine (silver)
obtain: Made from ingredients of the same grade, or improved from the grade below.

name: Wood wedge
obtain: Made at the Chopping Spot from 1 Short Log.

name: Wooden Anvil
obtain: Wooden Anvil is built in the Yard for 1 Short Log and 1 Stone. Unlocked by Bronze Works. Its construction site needs Building mastery 2: below that, hits do nothing.

name: Wooden beam
obtain: Made at the Circular Saw from 1 Log. Sold by the Furniture Maker and the Builder.

name: Wooden Billet
obtain: Wooden Billet is not obtainable in version 1.010 of the game: no recipe, formula, trader, quest, battle, chest or gathering spot gives it, nothing uses it and no trader buys it.

name: Wooden Cross I
obtain: Made at the Woodworking Workbench I from 2 Wooden Plank and 2 Bronze Nails. 2 wreaths on a grave.

name: Wooden Cross II
obtain: Made at the Woodworking Workbench I from 2 Wooden Plank and 2 Iron Nails. 3 wreaths on a grave.

name: Wooden Fence I
obtain: Made at the Woodworking Workbench I from 2 Wooden Plank and 2 Bronze Nails. 1 wreath on a grave.

name: Wooden Fence II
obtain: Made at the Woodworking Workbench I from 2 Wooden Plank and 2 Iron Nails. 2 wreaths on a grave.

name: Wooden Joint
obtain: Made at the Woodworking Workbench II from 2 Wooden beam and 1 Advanced Detail. Sold by the Furniture Maker and the Builder.

name: Wooden Kit I
obtain: Made at the Woodworking Workbench I from 3 Wooden Plank and 1 Oiled Plank. Assembly bench I also makes it. Sold by the Furniture Maker.

name: Wooden Kit II
obtain: Made at the Assembly bench II from 1 Special Wood. The quest The House at the Crossroads takes it.

name: Wooden Plank
obtain: Made at the Circular Saw from 1 Log. Woodworking Workbench I also makes it. Sold by the Furniture Maker and the Builder. The quest Jack in a Boat takes it.

name: Wooden Sign
obtain: Made at the Woodworking Workbench I from 2 Board and 2 Stick. A chest in the Graveyard holds it when the game starts. 1 wreath on a grave.

name: Wooden Trinkets
obtain: Made at the Woodworking Workbench I from 4 Oiled Plank and 8 Wood wedge. No recipe, formula, building, order or quest uses it.

name: Woodworking Workbench I
obtain: Woodworking Workbench I is built in the Yard for 8 Board and 4 Bronze Nails. Unlocked by Woodworking I. Its construction site needs Building mastery 2: below that, hits do nothing.

name: Woodworking Workbench II
obtain: Woodworking Workbench II is built in the Yard for 4 Oiled Plank and 2 Polished Bronze. Unlocked by Woodworking II. Its construction site needs Building mastery 2: below that, hits do nothing.

name: Worms Bait
obtain: Worms Bait is not obtainable in version 1.010 of the game: no recipe, formula, trader, quest, battle, chest or gathering spot gives it, nothing uses it and no trader buys it.

name: Writing Desk
obtain: Writing Desk is built in the Writing Basement for 4 Wooden Plank, 6 Bronze Nails and 1 Polished Bronze. Unlocked by Writing Basic. Its construction site needs Building mastery 2: below that, hits do nothing.

name: Written Softcover Book
obtain: Written Softcover Book is not obtainable in version 1.010 of the game: no recipe, formula, trader, quest, battle, chest or gathering spot gives it, nothing uses it and no trader buys it.

name: Yogurt
obtain: Made at the Kitchen Table from 1 Jug of Milk and 1 Honey. Using it restores 30 energy (33 while Steamed Up lasts).

name: Zombie
obtain: A corpse resurrected on the Resurrection Table becomes a zombie. The quests Friendship Written in the Stars and Sweet Dreams give zombies. A zombie can be placed on the Autopsy Table or the Embalming Table; graves, crematoriums and the Resurrection Table take corpses only. Personal Zombie Zone needs a zombie with...

name: Zombie Carousel
obtain: Zombie Carousel is built in the Factory for 6 Bronze Gear, 6 Iron Detail and 4 Wooden beam. +10 Factory power (20 with Belt Master). Unlocked by Zombie Gears. Its construction site needs Building mastery 4: below that, hits do nothing.

name: Zombie goo
obtain: Sold by Gunter. A reward for winning Break Through to the Port, Eastern Districts: Active Scouting or any of 15 other battles.

name: Zombie Marble Quarry
obtain: Zombie Marble Quarry is built in the Quarry for 2 Piece of stone and 4 Wooden Plank. Unlocked by Zombie Marble Mining.

name: Zombie Mechanism
obtain: Made at the Assembly bench II from 1 Engineering Kit and 1 Zombie Power.

name: Zombie Miner
obtain: Zombie Miner is built in the Old Mine for 2 Wooden Plank and 4 Brick. Unlocked by Zombie Mining.

name: Zombie Motivator Potion
obtain: Brewed by alchemy from ingredients whose runes add up to 1 red and 1 blue. Sold by the Alchemist. It grants Zombie Motivation (15 s).

name: Zombie Motivator Potion II
obtain: Brewed by alchemy from ingredients whose runes add up to 1 red and 2 blue. Sold by the Alchemist. It grants Zombie Motivation II (30 s).

name: Zombie Motivator Potion III
obtain: Brewed by alchemy from ingredients whose runes add up to 3 red and 3 blue. Sold by the Alchemist. It grants Zombie Motivation III (1 min).

name: Zombie Power
obtain: Made at the Bioreactor from 5 Wheat. The quest Magic Mirror takes it.

name: Zombie Stone Quarry
obtain: Zombie Stone Quarry is built in the Quarry for 2 Piece of stone and 4 Wooden Plank. Unlocked by Zombie Stone Mining.

name: Zombie Supplier Station
obtain: Zombie Supplier Station is built in the Yard, Quarry, Vineyard Basement, Writing Basement and 2 more areas for 4 Wooden Plank and 4 Bronze Nails. Unlocked by Zombie Assistant and Kitchen II.

name: Zombie Supply Porter
obtain: Zombie Supply Porter is built in the Factory for 4 Wooden Plank, 8 Iron Nails and 2 Iron Detail. Unlocked by Zombie Delivery.
